name: Ads performance monitor
description: Daily pull of ad-campaign performance from a sheet of campaign IDs. OpenHuman fetches metrics, writes them back, and emails you a digest. Read-only on the ads side, no posting.

proposed_workflows.name: Ads monitor — daily metrics pull + digest
proposed_workflows.description: Daily 8am: for each campaign row, fetch yesterday's metrics, write back, then send a single digest summarising spend + CTR + conversions.

config.prompt: For ad campaign {{record.campaign_id}} on platform {{record.platform}}, fetch yesterday's metrics (spend, impressions, clicks, conversions) via the appropriate API. Read-only — no posting/editing. Write the numbers back into the sheet row.
Compose a daily ads digest from yesterday's pull. Group by platform. Highlight top 3 spenders + bottom 3 ROAS. Send via Gmail to the user.

rationale_at_seed: for_each pulls per-campaign metrics; max_per_run=100 covers typical agency-scale portfolios.
on_error=continue so one bad row (e.g. revoked API token) doesn't kill the whole pull.
Final send_digest runs once after the iteration completes; DraftAndApprove queues the email for review.
Templates Phase-5 triage mode is the better policy here; F4-17 ships with draft-and-approve as the placeholder until triage lands.
Read-only monitoring campaign: no throttle (we never SEND, we just pull metrics).
Single sub-workflow covering pull + digest. The agent picks the right API per row's `platform` column.
The Phase-5 triage approval policy is the natural fit; until that lands, draft_and_approve gates the digest email.
